title: Verifying a User's Traffic is Being Forwarded to the Zscaler Service

blocks.text: To check if a user's traffic is going to the Zscaler service, on the user's device, go to ip.zscaler.com. The My IP Address page provides details about the Zscaler cloud to which the device is sending its traffic and links to additional tools you can use to check connectivity.

Zscaler's My IP Address service (ip.zscaler.com) might not recognize IPv6 traffic passing through the Zscaler cloud. Exercise caution when using the My IP Address service for troubleshooting or verifying connectivity to the Zscaler cloud when IPv6 is enabled on the client.
On the My IP Address page, you can view the following information:

blocks.item: The Zscaler cloud and the location of the Public Service Edge for Internet & SaaS (ZIA) to which your traffic is going
The egress IP address of the Public Service Edge
The virtual IP address of the Public Service Edge
The Zscaler hostname of the Public Service Edge instance that is processing your traffic
The egress IP address of the network from which the Public Service Edge receives traffic
The IP address of your gateway
